name: evalexpr_rhai
description: Evaluate a Rhai expression or full script and return the result as a DuckDB `UNION` of `ok` (the JSON-encoded result on success) or `error` (the error message on failure). With one argument, the script runs with no per-row context. With two arguments, the second is a `JSON` object exposed inside the script as `context.<field>` — the standard pattern for per-row evaluation; a `NULL` context runs the script without a `context` variable. Compiled scripts are cached per thread, so repeat evaluations skip the parse step. In the DuckDB 2.0 build every evaluation is bounded by the `evalexpr_rhai_max_operations`, `evalexpr_rhai_max_string_size`, `evalexpr_rhai_max_array_size`, `evalexpr_rhai_max_map_size` and `evalexpr_rhai_max_call_levels` settings, a running script can be cancelled, and scripts have no filesystem access. The function is `VOLATILE`: scripts can call random-number functions, so every row is evaluated.

examples.code:
SELECT name,
       evalexpr_rhai('context.salary > 100000',
                     { 'salary': salary }).ok AS high_earner
FROM employees;
